SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ulp.total_point DESC, ulp.modified_time IS NULL, ulp.modified_time DESC, ulp.created_time DESC ) AS rank,
-- user info u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name,
-- avatar f.id AS avatar_file_id, f.object_key,
-- learning progress ulp.id AS user_learning_progress_id, ulp.total_point,
-- oauth oap.id AS o_auth_provider_id, oap.avatar_url
FROM users u JOIN user_learning_progresses ulp ON u.user_learning_progress_id = ulp.id LEFT JOIN files f ON u.avatar_file_id = f.id LEFT JOIN o_auth_providers oap ON u.id = oap.user_id JOIN leagues l ON l.id = #{leagueId}
WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ulp.total_point >= l.min_point AND (l.max_point IS NULL OR ulp.total_point <= l.max_point)) leaderboard ORDER BY rank LIMIT 10;
